parameter.name: connection
parameter.label: Connection
parameter.description: Automatic uses the portal when credentials are set, otherwise the local network.

parameter.name: email
parameter.label: Email
parameter.description: Email address of the portal account.

parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Hostname
parameter.description: Network address of the thermostat, needed for a local connection.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: How often the thermostat is polled, at least 60 with the portal connection.

parameter.name: clientId
parameter.label: Client ID
parameter.description: Stable pseudo-MAC used to identify this binding to the thermostat. Auto-generated on first pairing — leave blank.
